scope: Question about overall image quality; no new generation or restoration authorized by this question.

visual_assessment.principal_source_issue: The current plate has etched/pockmarked foreground stone and fused, ornamental-looking cliff detail; the original terrace had quieter and more natural material surfaces. Similar defects are already visible in v7, before this animation.
visual_assessment.comparison: Farpoint has cleaner object edges and quieter coherent material surfaces at the same native image dimensions; resolution alone does not explain the difference.
visual_assessment.animation_contribution: Downsampling to 720p reduces fine detail; overlapping cloud texture fields can soften sky detail. Protected stone geometry is not regenerated by the animation.
visual_assessment.generation_history: v11 came from v7; records explicitly disclaim exact outside-sky pixel preservation. Do not describe this as eleven sequential resamplings.
visual_assessment.export: The 4K PNG exactly matches deterministic enlargement of v11. Colour validation for the correct video decoder shows small expected conversion differences; export compression does not explain the artificial source textures.

recommendation: Repair the clean source materials against the earlier natural-looking artwork while preserving the chosen composition and clear-sky/world arrangement; compare at native size before rebuilding motion. No stronger sharpening or additional upscaling presented as a fix.
